notes.title: November 21th, 2024 Ver.3.0.2 Notice on adjustments and bug fixes
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver. 3.0.2 was released on November 21th, 2024.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][u]Adjustments[/u][/b][/h2]
[h3]Unlock Events[/h3]
[list]
[*] Previously, unlocking TOWN required not only playing FOREST but also adding Hallow and Obake to your family. This condition has been relaxed, and now TOWN can be unlocked simply by playing FOREST, as indicated in the text.
[*] The combo advice provided by Shirohera and others previously appeared only when a certain score wasn’t achieved. It will now appear unconditionally.
[/list]
[h3]Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brief explanations are now displayed for each item in the options menu.
[*] Adjustments were made to the controller settings.
You can now swap the confirm and cancel buttons instead of assigning them individually.
Due to this change, controller settings from versions 3.0.1 and earlier will be reset to default.
[/list]
[h3]Spelunk Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now return to the menu by exiting the cave.
[/list]

That concludes the content of this update.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][u]Upcoming Updates[/u][/b][/h2]
This year, with the release of the Switch version, many of you have played ECHOLOCAUTION.
Thank you so much!

As a token of our gratitude, the next update will include a small event where you can hear conversations between bats other than Hina during Spelunk Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/f4bb07f866adb079f526d57026c7355f1a186605.png[/img]

We hope you continue to enjoy ECHOLOCAUTION!

notes.title: May 11th, 2023 Ver.3.0.1 Notice on adjustments and bug fixes
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver. 3.0.1 was released on May 11th, 2023.
Please check here for additional elements of the big update that we recently made.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545250/view/3728460558918564916

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][u]Detailed Adjustments[/u][/b][/h2]
[h3]Result Screen[/h3]
[list]
[*] The ranking of the stage played this time is now displayed on the left part of the screen.
You can check your high score and see at a glance which stage your score is for this time.
[/list]
[h3]Option[/h3]
[list]
[*] When performing key configuration, the input standby state is now canceled if the corresponding button is not pressed for a certain period of time.
[/list]
[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hallow
[i]- Echo Time：0.5 sec → 0.66 sec[/i]
The echo duration has been slightly extended, allowing you to consistently eat bugs within the combo bonus even at the end of the combo route. The adjustment aims to maintain the experience of discerning the combo route and catching in a moment, while reducing stress when you accidentally eat a bug due to combo break.
[/list][list]
[*] Yama & Kitty
[i]- Echo Time：2.5 sec → 2.66 sec
- Echo gauge charge start time: 0.5 sec. before the end of echo → 1 sec. before the end of echo
- Echo gauge charge speed multiplier: 1x → 1.5x[/i]
Yama & Kitty received many comments about being difficult to handle due to their distinctive performance, so we made their echo easier to accumulate to improve usability. As a result, it's easier to aim when sending Kitty far away as it's easier to spot bugs over a wide range. Also, we slightly extended the echo time and strengthened it to make it easier to simply connect combos.
[/list][list]
[*] Madara
[i]- Maximum echo time: approx. 4.8 sec. to 3.5 sec.
- Echo gauge charge speed multiplier: 1.5x → 1.75x[/i]
As for Madara... there was a bug where the gauge consumption speed was unintentionally incorrect, so we made adjustments and corrections to ensure an appropriate echo duration. While the maximum echo duration has significantly decreased from the release time, making it weaker, we have instead quickened the echo recovery time to make it easier to use. The duration is shorter, but the echo duration is still the longest among all bats! There is no change in the characteristic of being able to connect many combos if you accumulate to the maximum.
[/list][list]
[*] Kaguya
[i]- Echo absorption: 120% → 100%[/i]
Kaguya, who made her debut in the Ver.3 update, was adjusted to be a powerful bat. However, we reflected that she might have been a bit too strong, so we lowered the absorption power of the echo and made an adjustment to make it harder to absorb while dashing.
[/list]
[h2][b][u]Bug Fixed[/u][/b][/h2]
[h3]System-related[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where collections that should have been picked up were not being acquired.
[*] Fixed an issue where damage could be taken when retrying or returning to the menu from the pause screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor would end up on the Change when returning to the menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor would end up on the Forest when opening stage selection after playing in the Town.
[*] Fixed an issue where the name could appear in the unacquired state when opening Town's collection.
[*] Fixed an issue where the crown mark was not correctly applied to the minimum record.
[/list]
[h3]Character-related[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where fades state remained when using Super Echo while fades with Obake.
[*] Fixed an issue where Kitty's animation wouldn't play correctly if Yama took damage during Echo.
[*] Fixed an issue where the combo would continue even if the echo was interrupted when Madara was echoing while keeping the button pressed.
[/list]
[h3]Currently confirmed unfixed bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Depending on the environment in which you play, the customization of the keysettings may not function and the game may become inoperable.
If you lose control of the game, you will need to stop the game once.
[/list]
We are currently working to correct these issues. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

[hr][/hr]
These are the details of this update.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

We look forward to your continued support of Ecolocation!

notes.title: April 28th, 2023 Ver.3.0.0 Notice on detailed adjustments and bug fixes
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver. 3.0.0 was released on April 28, 2023.
Please refer to this link for additional features.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545250/view/3728460558918564916

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][u]Detailed Adjustment[/u][/b][/h2]
[h3]Text Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Both English and Spanish translations have been supervised and are now more correct.
[*] The pitch of the conversational voice has been changed for each character.
[*] Fixed an issue where texts would unnaturally break lines in the middle of dialogues.
[/list]
[h3]Collections[/h3]
[list]
[*]If you research a collection you have not yet acquired, you can now receive hints from Shirohera about the conditions for acquiring it.
[/list]
[h3]Ranking[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/7e9242bfeaea3fb68bc880f9d40c32d414818ae6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The layout has been changed with the addition of bats and stages.
[*] Items that have taken first place in records other than scores are now marked with a crown.
[/list]
[h3]Bat Index[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/8934e694cf7f8643cdd14784d2d5d655bc19aa1d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The layout has been changed with the addition of bats and stages.
[/list]
[h3]Character Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hina [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/8188d0feae64b76ce1c4e7127a4003dc228976f3.png[/img]

- Echo Time：2.5 sec → 2.66 sec
[/list]Hina had a harder time aiming for high scores compared to the other bats,
We have extended the echo time a little to make it easier to increase the number of combos.

[list]
[*] Ohiki [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/f981973cc185e7ccce80da85fb04a0014363c2f1.png[/img]
- Echo Time：2 sec → 2.33 sec
- Echo gauge charge speed multiplier: 1x → 1.25x
[/list]Ohiki was also less likely to aim for high scores than other bats,
We have adjusted the echo time to make it easier to increase the number of combos.

[list]
[*] Usagi [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/1c28c1aa544730a6213def75f23a09505c11d1e7.png[/img]
- Echo gauge charge start time: 1 sec. before the end of echo → 1.5 sec. before the end of echo
[/list]Usagi has adjusted the gauge so that when the echo is reused at its fastest, it is more fully gauged than in the past.
This will increase the range of vision with the echo and make it easier to determine combo routes.

As the number of unique new bats has increased, the initial trio has been training their hunting skills in a losing cause!

[list]
[*] Obake [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/086d8406e5a8d580e9e6243997a42e4ddd0b4b50.png[/img]
- Acceleration: 2 → 4
- Echo Time：2 sec →2.25 sec
- Echo gauge charge start time: 0.5 sec. before the end of echo → 1 sec. before the end of echo
- Echo gauge charge speed multiplier: 1.2x → 1.25x
- Acceleration (Fades): 6 → 2.5
[/list]Obake has been a powerful bat with the tactic of using a slowing echo to gather insects in one place for an oversized combo.
However, while it was powerful, we feel that it was in a position where it was difficult to make adjustments that would strengthen it.

Obake was originally conceived to be a beginner bat that could be easily avoided with Fades and easily eaten by stopping insects with Echoes.
One of the reasons for its appearance as the first hidden bat was that it was also supposed to be for beginners.
However, with previous Obake bats, on the contrary, they were more difficult to operate and were more for advanced users,
We decided to make a drastic rework, adjusting it specifically for ease of handling.

First, acceleration has been increased, making it easier to turn around the movement.
Instead, the acceleration at Fades has been reduced, but this is an improvement over the original, which was too high and therefore difficult to maneuver.
For obake, which has no dash and cannot make quick turns, the enhanced mobility is a significant enhancement.
We can now catch up a little with the speed of the much admired Ohiki.

Next, we have also made some adjustments related to echoes.
When the echo is reused at the fastest speed, the gauge is now more accumulated than before, though,
This is not a simple enhancement, but also a weakening factor.
Why is that? Because the increased minimum size of the echo makes it harder to use the tactic of gathering insects close to the Obake.
This adjustment is more important for the original concept of "stopping insects and making them easier to eat" than for more difficult tactics.
However, since it would be unbalanced to make it too weak, we have also made some adjustments to increase the echo time a little and make it easier to increase the number of combos.

The feel of the new Obake will be very different from the previous version, but we hope you will enjoy hunting with the new, more honest Obake.

[list]
[*] Yama & Kitty [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/4cfc5ab07e0798782bc9a44ec04f256245d759cb.png[/img]
- Kitty's echo size: 1/3 of Yama's echo size -> 2/3 of Yama's echo size
[/list]The echo size of the kitty has simply doubled, making it easier to find the bug where the kitty was flown.
I am worried about Yama's eardrums since they are now twice as loud.

[list]
[*] Tengu [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/7e7784c1b73fd1e264c097e680cc7a9b8ca101a0.png[/img]
- Acceleration: 2→3
- stopping power: 10→5
- Acceleration (in echo): 10→8
[/list]Tengu had a personality that increased the speed of movement while echoing,
However, there was a problem that it became too much faster than its normal speed, making it difficult to control.
Therefore, we increased Tengu's normal speed and slowed it down a little during echoes,
The difference between the two is not so large.
The increased acceleration is also intended to compensate for Tengu's inability to dash.

Although his mobility during echoes has decreased a little, it may be a sign that Tengu has grown up enough to be able to handle his masked state, where he used to be a rampaging horse.

[h3]New Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Madara [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/8a8f0f6088eae568efe3fa872b511690951ea444.png[/img]
[/list]Release condition: High score of 400 points or more.

Madara uses a special echo, not a fixed length echo like the other bats,
The echo is used for as long as the echo button is held down, and is interrupted when the echo button is released.
When an echo is triggered, the gauge is not consumed all at once, but rather gradually while the echo is being used.

If the echo gauge is built up to the maximum and used up to the end, the echo length is the longest among all bats!
It is difficult to manage the echo gauge, but if you master it, you can aim for an extra-large combo.

The characteristic of moving while holding down the echo button makes it difficult to dash at the same time, making it hard to make a quick turn,
However, its basic movement performance is high, so it can be operated comfortably even without a dash.


[list]
[*] Kaguya [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/28b9c9a986dafe73dc0b7e52c662c7332dad54ee.png[/img]
[/list]Release condition: Collect 5 specific collections.

Kaguya uses a special echo to attract and catch insects that enter within the echo's range.
It is a powerful echo, but it has a feature that shortens its effect time depending on the amount of echo gauge remaining when it is used.
In order to earn combos, it is important to accumulate the echo gauge as well as Madara before echoing.

Another feature is that instead of the echo gauge affecting the time of use, the size of the echo is fixed.
Echoes that form a beautiful circular shape resemble a full moon.

The stronger the echo, the lower the movement ability and the more slowly it moves, so beware of enemies more than usual.

[h2][b][u]Bug Fixed[/u][/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some count-based achievements could not be acquired.
If you start the game after the update, the flag for acquisition will be checked again.
[*] Fixed an issue where the text size was not correct and was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the text would sometimes overflow the frame depending on the language being displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue in which all characters were using fonts that were not compatible with Spanish when the language setting was set to Spanish.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character image would not display properly if the character landed on the ceiling or floor during the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Currently confirmed unfixed bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Depending on the environment in which you play, the customization of the controller settings may not function and the game may become inoperable.
If you lose control of the game, you will need to stop the game once.
[*] Collections that were supposed to be picked up in the town may not have been obtained.
This has been confirmed to occur when repeatedly hitting the "Result" screen.

We are currently working to correct these issues. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
[/list]

notes.title: April 28th, 2023 Ver.3.0.0 Update!
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver. 3.0.0 was released on April 28, 2023.

[hr] [/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/3108a7396555b67e2983de2a19a272303da9567a.png[/img]
The wait is over! Ecolorocation's major update is now live!
With new stages and characters added, the game has become even more enjoyable to play.

[h2][b][u]Update details[/u][/b][/h2]
[h3]Additional Stage![/h3]
[list]
[*]A new stage, "Mornmare," has been added.
[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/6b8867cf5cc2495bbb52797affc4f0c90b9e9126.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/8f01128abfea004b15185adabda2a9b07ee1d30b.png[/img]
[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/aa7572c165d15af921e26c4d4b498ec7f382974a.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/85ba95b869a6da4bc7de923efb16af536f73a812.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
This is the final stage that becomes playable after successfully completing hunts with all the bats.
The stage is set within Hina's dream.

Unlike the usual hunts, players face off against the nightmare "Mornmare."
Fill the gauge by eating insects and unleash the Super Echo!
Expose the core of the nightmare and deal damage with tackles.

Will Hina be able to overcome the nightmare and wake up safely?

Once cleared, Mornmare can be challenged with all the bats.
Unlike the Forest and Town stages, the time it takes to clear this stage will be recorded.
[/list]
[h3]Additional Characters![/h3]
[list]
[*]A new family member, "Madara," has arrived.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/58cd75b35d0ca9f5918f7f7c32ecbf28cf9eacd2.png[/img]
[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/f780ae4fadac5e743453cd8beefbbd3111218090.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/2f37d3ae974ea3927280b28c8ccfcdf963bd1a2d.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/d63c61f1ed1016f2f165410d6a7beca6515cdc5b.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/7d7ce75871266e84d0e8a5274cb9dc1921db241a.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
This bat is characterized by the spots on its back and takes pride in its own beauty.
Rumor has it that Madara fell in love with Mama at first sight and came to the house...?

Madara can continuously emit echolocation as long as the button is held down.
Its maximum echo duration is the longest among all the bats!
Catch your breath and connect plenty of combos at just the right moments!

Madara will come to your home when you score over 400 points in the high score.


[*]A new family member, "Kaguya," has arrived.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/4f32c69396d1658cb39e0b87f64f0db3bda9ca31.png[/img]
[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/dd01cf7030e01d0fd28aa8d7a2e9b56835ff5b5f.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/c2121937fab53701f56511238ee1810316620a2d.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/41bfc26ba0b19251201a2f6d6df65b7fd94c19ee.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/71be3422453ad41f066c3a63e21a8e83b0b68e28.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
She is calm and easy-going and doesn't easily notice when leaves are on her head.
Believing in the lore of his homeland, he sneaks into the bats' home in search of the moon's treasure ......?

Kaguya's echoes draw the insects closer to you.
The echo can last as long as the gauge is consumed, so it is effective to echo after a good breath of air!

Kaguya will come to your house when you collect 5 specific collections.
The clue is a treasure related to Kaguyahime ......?
[/list]
[h3]GameOver[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have made significant changes to the presentation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/b4557092f45edc1de94ba002d3076d8d857143a6.png[/img]
New background music has been added, giving the atmosphere a fresh change.
[/list]
[h3]Splunk Mode[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/64c6dfb362d309932c58138fc7d49e32a56b4003.png[/img]
[*] Balloons can now be popped.
[*] The bulldog bat has arrived.
[*] We have added new types of trophies for the hidden room.
A bronze trophy is awarded for 300 points, a silver trophy for 400 points, a gold trophy for 500 points, and a platinum trophy when you score 500 points in both the Forest and Town stages.
When all the pedestals have gold or higher trophies, Shirohera and others will celebrate with you.
[/list]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*]We have added in-game presentation for when achievements are obtained.
[*]Three new achievements have been added.
[/list]
[h3]Other Adjust and Bug Fixes[/h3]
We have also made adjustments to playable characters and UI design.
For more details, please check the link provided.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545250/view/3728460558918774585


[hr] [/hr]
[h2][b][u]Announcement[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3]New tracks added to the original soundtrack![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573600/ECHOLOCAUTION_Original_Soundtrack/

Five new BGM tracks have been added to ECHOLOCAUTION's original soundtrack.
New tracks by our bat friend fether have been added, including BGM for the Mornmea stage and game over music, as well as newly recorded music box arrangements of existing tracks!
With the addition of the BGM, the price will change starting today. We apologize for any inconvenience.

On the other hand, starting today, ECHOLOCAUTION's music is now available on YouTube!
URL:【 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLNfoEqXe6tBVg3sNoeSNLf0eCEJeNr8GH 】
Now you can listen to the tracks even without purchasing the original soundtrack, so we'd be happy if you could casually give them a listen or recommend them to others!
The original soundtrack includes not only the MP3 files of the songs but also bonus tracks and high-quality FLAC files, so it's perfect for those who want to enjoy ECHOLOCAUTION's music even more!

[h3]Official Artbook Now on Sale![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574350/ECHOLOCAUTION/

The official artbook for ECHOLOCAUTION is now available for purchase! The artbook is packed with illustrations by designer Fuwa and features all in-game graphics without omission. It also includes numerous rough sketches, unused designs, and rejected materials that can only be seen here. Each piece of art is accompanied by a brief comment. Moreover, the book contains fascinating stories about the game design by planner Kagehito. Enjoy the unique world of ECHOLOCAUTION that can only be experienced here!

In addition to the official artbook, a fan kit containing the title logo and character standing images is included! Feel free to use them as icons for social media or as materials for game streaming.

[h3]Streaming Policy[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545250/view/3728460558919116775

We have established streaming guidelines for "ECHOLOCAUTION."
Please read these guidelines when posting or streaming gameplay videos of "ECHOLOCAUTION" on video streaming sites.


[hr] [/hr]
[h3]In conclusion[/h3]

We still plan to make minor adjustments, but with this major update, we intend to conclude the development of "ECHOLOCAUTION" for the time being. We would like to express our gratitude once again to everyone who has loved this game and supported its development.

Our team, Hakoniwa Hakobiya, is looking forward to focusing on the development of new titles in the future. We appreciate your continued support for both "ECHOLOCAUTION" and Hakoniwa Hakobiya!

notes.title: Oct.31th,2021 Ver.2.00 Update Information
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver. 2.00 was released on Oct.31th,2021.
This will be a big update with many additional elements.

Also, the translation from Japanese to English is done using a translation tool.
I apologize that some of the sentences may be strange, but please bear with me.

[hr] [/hr]
[b][u]Update details[/u][/b]

Big update "ver2.00"!
Sorry for the wait! The first big update is coming to ECHOLOCAUTION.
One new stage and two new playable bats will be added to ......, or is it three?
Today's update is for Halloween, and Halloween means bats! We hope you will take this opportunity to come and meet these cute bats.

[list]
[*]A new stage, "Town," has been added.

[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/e68229ffc0797294ab85a62718e07e2e2a64d241.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/56a9f4ddff247ce2f92aa8395f628cb7c3afd4ef.png[/img]
[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/429a2dc066fcf351ec2a9e9d65d5964b64f0d69b.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/40f960f914d767daf491fe2dd7076f3579d79a8a.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
Unlike the previous "Forest" games, this time the adventure is a bit taller and takes place in a town!
There will be no Silent-Feather owls, but instead cats called Sharp-Claws by the bats will attack you.
Unlike Silent-Feather, which attacks from the side, Sharp-Claws attack vertically, so you need to change the direction you avoid them.
Sharp-Claws attack more frequently than Silent-Feather because of their collective behavior, which is another threatening factor.
After the birds, we are now dealing with the beasts. Let's keep our heads up.

There is also a tasty gimmick called "Electric Lamp" that lights up the path and collects insects at once.
Use them aggressively to score combos all at once!

Towns can be reached after several successful night hunts with "Obake" and "Hallow" added to the family.

[*]A new family member, Tengu, has been added.

[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/7c7440273f47bc444bdf6496cd0a4902c32e2030.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/303197153ea571e2e021b2014f47d6060811c09f.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
Masking his feeble nature with a mask, here comes Tengu, a windigo born in the north!
Tengu is a bat with the ability to put together insects by flying his whirlwind to the front instead of dashing.
The whirlwind will send the insects flying a little higher, so be sure to time your combos well before they become too hard to catch.

Also, during the echo, Tengu wears a predator mask, which makes him stronger and increases his movement speed.
This is not only to show the duality of the character, but also to help him avoid enemy attacks since he can't use his dash.

Tengu will come to your house when you complete the "Forest" collection.

[*]A new family member, Yama & Kitty, has been added.

[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/ac199f01385eae9cc8c81e0617de5d65c15bbec8.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/f48f71386dcf5bc296da0878cc840271fc34959c.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
Here comes the uneven duo of Yama, the largest species of Vespertilionidae, and Kitty, the smallest species of bat! 
Normally, Kitty rides on top of Yama and they move together, but when they dash, Kitty is detached and launched. 
While Kitty is detached, she will try to return to Yama's direction, so she can move like a boomerang. It is possible to dash again on the way.
 When the detached Kitty approaches Yama, it will be set above his head once again, making it easier to aim for hunt to fly.
Also, since Kitty is not damaged by natural enemies, you can force her to catch bugs that are difficult to catch because of natural enemies.
It's a bit difficult to control, but it's a technical character that scratches an itch.

Yama is large and can easily catch insects, and its maximum speed is faster than Ohiki's, although its acceleration is slow.
On the other hand, as a heavyweight, Yama is hard to maneuver, and he has to take the risk of not being able to dash, which makes it difficult for him to avoid attacks from his natural enemies.
This is a character for advanced players who need to keep an eye on Yama's position while controlling Kitty.

Yama & Kitty will come to your house when you complete the "Town" collection.

[*]A new mode, "Spelunk", has been added.

[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/07d909ce1472619e7a16aad421218c936694adb5.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/8d4d67e83171c149876d72a8434ac22c3c3827d1.png[/img]
[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/b1571e48d64e2ca355fd030231d2353403b43a14.png[/img]
[/th][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/56e9989b774f69e921477f053da820daca95fee3.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
Spelunk has been added to the game, where you can take a break from hunting at night and explore the caves that are home to bats.
You can talk with your fellow bats and play with the collections you've collected.
There may be hidden rooms in the cave that can only be seen through echoes......?

Spelunk can be reached from the "Home" menu at the bottom left of the menu.

Also, this update is a bit inadequate as we were not able to meet the expected volume in time.
We are planning to add more character conversations in future updates, so we hope you will be patient with us.

[*]A new menu item, Directory, has been added.

[table][tr][th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/f27bb157146a760e8130a985ce4ff1348ccb2aea.png[/img]
[/th]
[th]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/9d176e843cc735a7325ea2fba9b5e8c4f862aa35.png[/img]
[/th][/tr][/table]
The "Directory" menu has been added to allow you to learn more about the characters that appear in the work.
The character descriptions that were previously available in the Character Change menu have been ported to the Directory.
You will also be able to read the descriptions of non-playable characters.
You can also see the various motions of the bats by pressing the decision button on the character page.
[/list]

[b][u]Other adjustments[/u][/b]

We have made various adjustments to the playable characters, UI design and layout adjustments, and more.
Details can be found on the following page.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545250/view/3095655347301791677

[b][u]About translation[/u][/b]

As with the original release, the translation of the added text from Japanese to English has been done by machine translation.
Please be forewarned that the text may look strange when you play the game in English.

Thank you for your continued support of ECHOLOCAUTION!

notes.title: 12/04/2021 Ver.1.03 Update Information
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver.1.03 was released on 2021/04/12.
[hr] [/hr]
[b][u]Update contents[/u][/b]

[Adjustment]
[list]
[*] The dead zone of the controller stick has been widened.
Until now, the controller sticks had a high sensitivity to northeast input, which tended to cause erroneous operation during menu operations and directional input during dashing.
By widening the dead zone, nana-angle input is now less likely to occur, making it easier to operate the controller in a horizontal or vertical direction.
[/list]
[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the "I'm so full!" and "I'm starving." achievements could not be obtained at the correct time.
[*]Fixed a bug where characters could not be changed when starting the game for the first time or after initializing the save data.
[*]Fixed a bug where achievements that should have been obtained when scoring 300 and 400 were not reflected in the in-game achievements list.
[/list]
[hr] [/hr]

Thank you for your continued support of ECHOLOCAUTION!

notes.title: 10/04/2021 Ver.1.02 Update Information
notes.notes:
ECHOLOCAUTION Ver.1.02 was released on 2021/04/10.
[hr] [/hr]
[b][u]Update contents[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Major changes have been made to the design of the ranking screen.
More records will be added, and achievements will be viewable in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/bb4410230ae2511cac1b04328525fab79d3ddf9c.png[/img]


[*]The clear screen now shows the detailed data of that day's hunt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39979501/191cfb4a2f7da5a9f577b9a3062cd02ac4b4681d.png[/img]


[*] English text has been refurbished.

[*] Changed the notation of the buttons based on the Xbox controller.

[*] Deceleration of Ohiki's dash has been made faster.
The distance between the dashes is now less than before, making them easier to control.

[*] Two new achievements have been added.

[olist]
[*] [b]Miracle result![/b]
Proof of a score of triples.
[*] [b]Masterfully done![/b]
Proof of completion of all achievements.
[/olist]
Also, achievements that were not handled well by the acquisition process, including those added last time, will now be retrieved at startup if they are confirmed.
[/list]

[b][u]Other bug fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Hallow's max combo was not being saved correctly.

[*] Fixed meteor shower days so that you can see a clear sky.
[/list]
[hr] [/hr]
[u][b]Upcoming updates[/b][/u]
We are currently working hard on this, so the implementation date is still undecided, but we hope to add the following elements.
[list]
[*] Addition of a free mode where you can freely explore the cave as a place where mom and little bats can interact with each other.

[*] Add a new stage that can be enjoyed in a different way from the forest.

[*] Added more bats that can be used to expand the range of play.

[*] Added accessories to make your favorite bats look even more like your favorite bats.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of ECHOLOCAUTION!
